subject: math
description: Learn how to find the radius from a diameter before calculating the area of a circle.
learningObjectives: Identify diameter and radius in circle diagrams and word problems
Find the radius by dividing the diameter by 2
Use the formula A = pi r^2 to calculate circle area
Explain why using the diameter as the radius gives an area that is too large
Check circle-area solutions for the diameter-as-radius mistake
prerequisites: Know that radius is half of diameter
